name: about-bento

frames.best_why: All four cards, the heading and the stat are fully visible with the cursor off the content.

tagline: Bento about section with a big statement, growth stat and purple CTA.
summary: An about-us block: a centred headline over a grid of four cards. A large dark card states the mission beside a green growth stat, a small status tile and a wide violet community banner.
appearance: A dark section with a centred white headline and two-line subtitle, then a four-card bento: a large dark statement card with a violet pill, a tall green 450% stat card, a small near-black tile and a wide violet community strip with a round arrow.
behaviour: The layout is mostly still; the arrow on the community card is a pointer target, and hovering the statement card slowly spins the faint star behind its text.
demo_content: About Our Impact, 450% avg growth, Atomic Habits status tile, join 12,000+ entrepreneurs.
search_phrases: join community call to action card
who we are block for landing page
use_when: A marketing site needs a compact about block that pairs a mission statement with one impressive metric.
avoid_when: All copy and numbers are hardcoded, so every word must be edited in the file before use.
customise: All text, the 450% figure, the 80% bar width, the star shape and card colours are written inside the component, so changes need a source edit.
weight_why: Static markup and CSS transitions; no script runs after mount.

a11y.note: The community banner looks clickable but is a plain div with no link, button role or focus style.

issues: The status tile's mono subtitle is barely legible against the near-black card.
polish_why: Bold, coherent bento with strong colour blocks; some secondary text is too dim on dark cards.
title: About Bento
